verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS equity-management platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions an API, API keys, tokens, or agent credentials. The only related evidence is administrator permissions and custom roles for human users, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit toward scoped API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
